recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the profiling-page portion of the published FHIR-5582 decision while preserving later refined ElementDefinition.isSummary semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5582 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that mandatory base resource or datatype elements be included in summary, with build-tool enforcement plus notes in ElementDefinition.isSummary and profiling about profiles that make optional elements mandatory.
initial_application: The explicit application commit was svn 3983, imported as 8997ed2d40dafcfdc82b74e5a16b4a6891679f5f, which added publisher validation for mandatory summary elements but did not add the profiling.html note. Later commits and Jira decisions added and refined the ElementDefinition.isSummary definition and search-page link.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active datatype and profiling.html is an active core profiling narrative page. FHIR-9201 established that isSummary cannot be overridden in profiles, FHIR-33148 refined the current isSummary inclusion rule and exceptions, and FHIR-35855 removed confusing per-profile wording without changing the no-override rule.
reconciliation: Edited source/profiling.html in the Changing Cardinality section to explain that _summary=true responses are based on base-resource isSummary markings and that profile-level mandatory non-summary elements might be absent from such summaries.
source_changes: source/profiling.html: added a Changing Cardinality note about _summary=true, base isSummary markings, and possible non-conformance when profiles make non-summary elements mandatory.
